title: Director at a Value-Added Reseller Is Optimistic About CrowdStrike Growth, Renewals, and Falcon Flex Adoption
expert: Sales Director at a value-added reseller, 9+ years selling CrowdStrike (current; own deals and renewals)
verdict: The expert's own CrowdStrike business grew about 20% y/y in Aug–Oct, with renewal spend up 10%–15% on 5%–10% annual price increases and about 60% of deals on Falcon Flex.

NNARR vs bogey (channel growth): CrowdStrike business ~20% y/y (Aug–Oct), below the 30%+ partner growth in Aug channel checks (SB #43076). → Tenet 1 (Flex/NNARR) ↑
renewal spend +10%–15% y/y, consistent with 100% of the original Flex cohort renewing (SB #44215). → Tenet 1 (Flex/NNARR) ↑
Flex utilization: ~60% of deals on Flex with ~10% deal-size uplift vs management's 40% ending-ARR uplift on Flex conversion (SB #59489): smaller uplift in this channel. → Tenet 1 (Flex/NNARR) →
FY29 model / margins: 5%–10% annual subscription price increases vs Bernstein's 25–35% Flex discount on like-for-like SKUs (SB #66649): conflicting. → Tenet 5 (margin/FCF) ↑
AIDR ARR conversion: recent AI-security deal lost to Palo Alto even as Falcon Guardian demand rises; Cleveland had AIDR becoming a standard Flex attach (SB #43077): mixed. → Tenet 2 (AIDR cycle) ↓

changes: Own CRWD business ~20% y/y vs partners citing 30%+ growth in Aug (SB #43076): slower.
Renewal spend +10%–15% y/y vs 100% of the original Flex cohort renewing (SB #44215): consistent.
Flex deal-size uplift ~10% vs management's 40% ending-ARR uplift on Flex conversion (SB #59489): lower.
Annual price increases 5%–10% vs Bernstein 25–35% Flex discount on like-for-like SKUs (SB #66649): conflicting.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (Flex/NNARR): ↑ — ~20% growth, renewals +10%–15%, ~60% of deals on Flex.
Tenet 2 (AIDR cycle): ↓ — lost an AI-security deal to Palo Alto; Guardian demand rising but unquantified.
Tenet 3 (emerging platform): ↑ — Falcon Cloud Security taking share from Wiz; NG-SIEM and Cloud lead the pipeline.
Tenet 4 (core endpoint): ↑ — "isn't losing endpoint share"; SentinelOne discounting has not stopped CRWD wins.
